Transitive through nuxt > @nuxt/devtools, which runs only under `nuxt dev` in this repo's Nuxt example and theme package (the published Nuxt packages take nuxt as a peer). @nuxt/devtools 3.4.2 (latest stable) still requires simple-git ^3.36.0 and imports its default export, which the patched 4.x major removed, so forcing 4.x breaks `nuxt dev`.
